parameters.content:
## Lqitha - multi-agent lost & found (Tunisia)
Entry: POST /webhook/lqitha from the web app.
**Agents (LLM, Groq):** 1 Intake/Router - 2 Perception (vision) - 4 Verifier - 5 Recovery plan (agentic RAG: 5a planner, 5b re-ranker, 5c writer, 5d checker) - 6 Notifier - 6b Claim check - 8 Found-items search answer
**Tools (HTTP, Lqitha API):** speech-to-text, save report, matcher (3), multi-source RAG retrieval, found-items search, claims, notifications.
Prompts are generated from prompts/prompts.yaml (single source of truth).

parameters.content:
## Agent 5 - Recovery plan (agentic RAG)
**5a Planner** splits the situation into 2-5 French sub-questions, each routed to a source family (administration / law / operator / sop) and an item type. **Tool** runs one search per sub-question. **5b Re-ranker** keeps max 2 useful passages per sub-question. **5c Writer** builds the timed plan + letter with [n] citations. **5d Checker** (another model) labels each step; unsupported steps are removed.

parameters.content:
## Found-items search (multimodal RAG)
The user's text OR photo is normalised by the Perception agent into the same English record as the indexed found items. **Tool**: dense retrieval + soft constraints (same category, place and plausible date add a bonus, never exclude). **Agent 8** re-ranks the candidates and answers with item references.
